decision: accept the lazy wrapper capability or retain a precise source-level blocker
implementation_boundary: SpikeInterface time-by-channel recording request to installed Kilosort 4.0.27 BinaryFiltered.filter output immediately before whitening

frozen_semantics.request_context: filter exactly the parent interval requested by the consumer; do not invent, trim or reuse context
frozen_semantics.fft_length: installed BinaryFiltered.filter receives NT equal to that exact requested interval length
frozen_semantics.output: time-by-selected-channel float32, original selected channel IDs/order/geometry and segment clock
frozen_semantics.dartsort: preprocessing=none must return the wrapper unchanged and preserve exact trace values; copy_recording_to_tmpdir=no and work_in_tmpdir=false remain run-contract requirements

acceptance: exact array equality to an eager installed-BinaryFiltered reference for request lengths 63, 64, 127 and 256
exact padded-request equality and exact cropped-core equality to the same eager padded request
positive control shows filtering the core without padding is not silently treated as padded-core equivalence
nonzero segment origins and multiple segment clocks are unchanged
selected/reordered channel IDs and geometry are unchanged
explicit nonunit scale and shift match eager reference
wrapper construction performs zero parent reads and each request reads only its exact interval
integer and uint16 inputs produce float32 outputs with Kilosort signed/scale semantics

a separate exact DARTsort interpreter consumer proves the actual dartsort entrypoint boundary selects no copy, preprocessing=none returns the same object, ds_all_to_workdir returns the same object with no work directory, and trace values remain exact
invalid empty requests, duplicate/unknown channels and nonfinite scale/shift fail closed

tolerance.reason: both paths invoke the same frozen installed Kilosort filter on identical float32 tensors

stop_condition: stop after immutable synthetic capability evidence and focused review; no real voltage or H5 execution
exclusions: no H5 contact, voltage read/hash, materialization/transfer, service, GPU, sort, RF/holdout or full-session launch
